_comment: EXP-SKY-012: dual-view (North + West) validation on the previously missing large_flat_city HardSwipe.
A targeted follow-up to EXP-SKY-011: ONE new run, scored against the IDENTICAL city reference memory
EXP-SKY-011 used (the paired reference list read from evaluations/sky-dual/cells/scores_city_*.npz and
rebuilt from the frozen observations_sim_dual store; the rebuilt bank must reproduce frozen score rows
to 1e-12 before any new query is scored). Every rule, threshold, region definition and gate is the
EXP-SKY-011 one: frozen_config supplies them and this file overrides only the paths of the new run,
its own store, its own SegFormer mask root and its own output directory, so nothing under
evaluations/sky-dual, observations_sim_dual or the frozen mask root is written.
DEV-frozen gates are read from evaluations/sky-dual/metrics.json (selected_gates); the frozen
baseline gate 0.90/0.15 (frame level) is the EXP-SKY-010 rule that accepted 58/97 of the old city
HardSwipe on SegFormer. No threshold is chosen on this run; the 4x4 grid is reported as sensitivity only.

veto_rule.name: north_primary_west_veto
veto_rule.definition: accept iff North passes its gate and NOT (West passes its gate with a top-1 outside North's top-1 region, tau_agree)
